title: Time Jump: 08:00, Cabinets Running Dry

fields.narration: It is now 08:00 on Monday, October 5, 2026. Since 07:40, the wholesaler's 40 percent cut has been loaded at order entry. The 07:30 cabinet restock run went out short. Restock lines for 1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% and the 250 mL minibags were cut, and the pharmacy system now shows those cabinet pockets as RESTRICTED on the nursing units. The emergency department, the medical-surgical units and the ICU each report at least one cabinet with its 1000 mL normal saline pocket at zero. Nurses have started working around it. Where patients can swallow, they are switching to oral hydration. Where they can find the pharmacy list, they are giving IV push instead of minibag piggybacks. They are also taking down keep-vein-open lines. Not every unit is doing all three. The 08:30 unit huddles start in 30 minutes. The Incident Commander is still waiting for pharmacy's one recommendation, Level 2 or Level 3, and it is due at 08:15.
worldState: Clock is 08:00, Monday, October 5, 2026. Unit huddles start at 08:30. Pharmacy's level recommendation to the Incident Commander (Dale Pruitt, ext. 3010) is due at 08:15.

Primary wholesaler allocation is active at order entry: 40 percent of baseline-period usage for 4 weeks. That is NaCl 0.9% 1000 mL at 952 bags/wk, LR 1000 mL at 336 bags/wk and NaCl 0.9% 250 mL at 1,148 bags/wk. Orders above these quantities are cut. No recovery date is available.
Secondary wholesaler (Des Moines) will not add new IV fluid volume. Prairie Ridge Health is on its waitlist only.
The 07:30 cabinet restock run went out short. NS 1000 mL and 250 mL minibag pockets are flagged RESTRICTED in the pharmacy system on nursing units.
The ED, the medical-surgical units and the ICU each have at least one automated dispensing cabinet with the NS 1000 mL pocket at zero.

Units are conserving on their own and not all in the same way. Some use oral hydration, some give IV push in place of minibags, some take down keep-vein-open lines. No pharmacy conservation notice has gone out yet.
Conference Room C (ext. 3690) has not been opened. No level has been declared.
fields.facilitatorNote: Hold the room to the 08:15 deadline. If no one gives the IC a single recommendation, have the IC call back at 08:15 and ask again. Units are each improvising their own conservation steps. This is the opening for one notice that matches what PH-22-A requires.
fields.scenarioTitle: Forty Percent: IV Fluid Allocation & Substitution Safety

instructorNote: Watch for the DOP to give the IC one recommendation by 08:15: Level 3, because a 40 percent allocation is below the plan's 50 percent threshold. The DOP should also ask the IC to open Conference Room C (ext. 3690). Also watch for the CPM to turn the PH-22-A section 2 conservation rules into one notice that the CNO pushes to all units before the 08:30 huddles, so the units stop improvising different steps.
